evidence_against.relevance: Casey regularly initiated contact and arranged approximately weekly one-on-one time over twelve weeks, indicating sustained interest.
Casey invested time in Drew's interview preparation and attended an event Drew identified as important.
Casey independently resumed regular contact after two periods apart, showing continuity of interest.

evidence_supporting.relevance: Casey twice declined to define the relationship and offered no timeline for revisiting it, supporting a low-commitment interpretation.
Meetings were generally convenient for Casey or arranged at short notice, and Casey canceled advance plans for other commitments.
Casey has not integrated Drew into close social or family circles and declined to make a plan two months ahead.

recommended_action.explanation: Drew could ask Casey what level of involvement Casey is willing to offer and whether the relationship question will be revisited, then compare that answer with Drew's needs.

uncertainty_explanation: Casey's consistent initiation, practical support, and resumed contact show meaningful interest, but the repeated refusal to define the relationship, convenience-oriented planning, cancellations, lack of social integration, and reluctance to plan ahead more strongly support involvement without meaningful commitment.
